title: Grilled Renkon Skewers with Souvlaki Sauce
description: A tasty and easy-to-make summer recipe featuring grilled renkon skewers served with a tangy souvlaki sauce. Perfect for a light lunch or dinner.
instructions: Cut the renkon into 1-inch pieces and thread them onto skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together the souvlaki seasoning, zesty Greek yogurt, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the renkon skewers with olive oil and season with souvlaki seasoning.
Grill the skewers over medium heat for 5-7 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Serve the grilled renkon skewers with the souvlaki sauce for dipping.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
